training_budget: Matched 900 optimizer updates and identical minibatch streams; total active time, frozen passes and teacher-cache time reported separately. Not an equal-time claim.
scope: Adaptive development follow-up. Existing train/V reused; new eight E origins per dataset after all parent targets. Adjacent same-series holdout, not independent source replication.
primary_hypothesis: Train-only quantile/patch calibration reliability allocates a fixed mean function-preservation penalty; known ingredients, novelty unresolved.
calibration_weight_formula: clip_min(exp(-4*abs(coverage-q)/sqrt(q*(1-q))),0.1), normalized to channel mean1; train origins[::2], 16-step patches
shuffled_control: Roll quantile axis by7 and horizon axis by16, preserving each channel weight distribution
